payload.body: **HEAD is lint-red, found while building WP-06: fix it once, not twice.** tests/lib/release_fixtures.bash, state_of's '<<<"$output"' is SC2154 (output referenced but not assigned). I measured it on HEAD's own copy of the file: 'check lint' gives 1 breach. It came in when state_of moved into the fixtures. The pre-commit gate doesn't run lint (lesson 75(c)), so it went in green, and CI's Linux job runs lint, so the next push goes red. I'm fixing it in my WP-06 commit with a scoped '# shellcheck disable=SC2154' and a reason (output is bats's, set by run). Leave it out of your WP-05 fix so we don't collide. If your fix lands first and you'd rather carry it, tell me and I'll drop mine. (C) hello@matthewsinclair.com
